title: Sent the Wrong Number of Parts - Can't Assemble
text:
Sent the Wrong Number of Parts - Can't Assemble. Unfortunately I have to give this wine rack a poor review. It looks like it's a nice wine rack, made of solid wood with beautiful finish.

However, in the box was the wrong number of parts. I got one too many 2-dowel arms and one too few 1-dowel arms. The result is a wine rack than cannot be assembled.

Mistakes do happen. I am trying to contact the manufacturer to see if I can get the right part shipped so I can properly assemble the rack. Assuming I can get the right piece from them, I will rewrite this review, factoring in the customer service experience as well. So far I am having a very difficult time tracking down contact information for the manufacturer as there is no contact info in the package and I have not had success finding company information online.

Until I can reach the manufacturer and try for resolution, I have a useless box of parts and I cannot give this wine rack a favorable review.
